title: Why Adults Can't Develop Perfect Pitch
summary: Rick Beato argues that adults cannot develop true perfect pitch, which he ties to critical-period brain plasticity and language acquisition. He says it can only be developed in young children, and discusses the research behind this.
why: HN points to it as the standard explanation of why perfect pitch is a childhood window, in threads about absolute pitch training.

quote.text: This video convinced me that adults cannot develop or train perfect pitch.
